interpretation.note: ADD-03/3.1 replaces the 90% minimum with an 85%-110% band of daily average flow at the inlet works. ADD-03/3.2 annotates 7.3 as unchanged. The pack does not say what happens if a day falls outside the band; that is for a person. Other points from the earlier reading still stand: the Independent Engineer certifies PCOD against this clause (VOL-V 1.5); the pack does not say how a 30-day rolling-average limit is 'met' within a 30-day run; late PCOD is covered by VOL-V 18.1 and 18.3.
